short_description: Consumer-facing physical trait that reports a cautious panel-relative signal related to adult height within the current local reference panel.
summary_note: Usable consumer-facing physical trait with the strongest current raw-array support and a clearer interpretation boundary between height-related genetic signal and real-world measured stature for the no-imputation workflow.
what_it_measures: A panel-relative polygenic signal associated with adult height tendency, calibrated within the current local empirical reference panel.
interpretation_template: Height is presented here as a cautious panel-relative signal, not as a direct prediction of measured adult height. {interpretation}
caution_text: Use as a cautious panel-relative signal only. No imputation or ancestry-adjusted normalization is used, and the output should not be treated as a deterministic real-world result or as a direct prediction of measured adult height.
limitations: Percentiles and z-scores are relative to the local reference panel, not to a population-wide benchmark.

Real-world measured height also depends on childhood nutrition, health, developmental environment, sex-specific effects, and other non-modeled factors, so this should not be treated as a precise prediction of adult height in centimeters.
confidence_note: Confidence reflects overlap and reference robustness under the no-imputation raw-array workflow, not certainty about the real-world trait.
reference_note: Percentiles and z-scores are calibrated against a local empirical reference artifact built from raw-array files in this project; they are panel-relative, not population-wide.
